prompt: A box plot has min $= 2$, $Q_1 = 5$, median $= 8$, $Q_3 = 11$, max $= 14$. What is the **range**?
hint: Five numbers are given, but the range uses only the two at the very ends.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Sort the data from least to greatest first — many statistics get easy after that.
Five numbers are given, but the range uses only the two at the very ends.
Ignore the quartiles and the median. Take the maximum $14$ and the minimum $2$ and subtract.
$14 - 2 = 12$, so the range of the data is $12$.

explanation: The range is the maximum minus the minimum, so the quartiles and median are not needed.
From the box plot, the maximum is $14$ and the minimum is $2$.
Subtract: $14 - 2 = 12$, so the range of the data is $12$.
